releases.name: v1.0.0
releases.body:
The first stable release of Freelens for Claude, and the first one for Freelens 2.

## Breaking changes

- **Requires Freelens 2.0.0 or newer.** The extension moves to the Freelens v2 extension API (`engines.freelens: ^2.0.0`) and no longer loads in Freelens 1.x. Stay on [v0.2.0](https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-for-claude-extension/releases/tag/v0.2.0) for Freelens 1.x. (#74)

## Highlights

- **Kubernetes requests go through the Freelens proxy.** The built-in tools send their requests through the Freelens Kubernetes API of the cluster, with the kubeconfig's authentication and the cluster's proxy setting, as the rest of Freelens does. A cluster that is not connected in Freelens is refused. The bundled `@kubernetes/client-node` is gone. (#84)
- **`freelens_kubectl` and `freelens_helm` run the cluster terminal's kubectl and helm**, in its environment, so they reach the cluster through the Freelens proxy too and pass no `--kubeconfig` or `--context`. A "Path to helm binary" preference is honored. (#87)
- **kubectl download progress in the tool card.** When the kubectl for the cluster's version is still being downloaded, the card of a kubectl or helm call shows the phase, a progress bar with the size, any problem the host reports (such as a fallback to the bundled kubectl), a failure or a stop. (#90)
- **Third-party providers work.** Sessions now pick up the provider and authentication settings of your Claude Code `settings.json` (`$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` or `~/.claude`): `env`, `modelOverrides` and the credential helpers (`apiKeyHelper`, `awsAuthRefresh`, `awsCredentialExport`, `gcpAuthRefresh`, `proxyAuthHelper`). Users on Bedrock, Vertex, Claude Platform on AWS, Foundry or a gateway no longer get "Not logged in". The file's `model` is the default for a chat with no model selected. Permissions, hooks, plugins and MCP servers of that file still stay out of the chat. (#93)

## Improvements and fixes

- Tool cards show the real outcome of a call: a red card for an error, a neutral state for a denied or stopped call, a check for success. A non-zero exit of kubectl or helm is not an error. Old transcripts keep a text-based fallback. (#92)
- The **Switch model** dialog shows the live model catalog of your Claude Code instead of only the fallback aliases. Concurrent requests share one session start, so the model list, context and usage no longer fail when the chat page opens, and a missing catalog is fetched again when the dialog opens or the chat reconnects. (#97)
- Reinstalling or reloading the extension with a chat open no longer leaves the chat without a bridge until Freelens restarts. (#111)
- `delete_with_finalizers` now sends a valid merge patch. (#84)

## Security

- The local bridge between the chat and the main process is hardened (#106):
  - the bearer token is compared in constant time;
  - CORS is allowed only for Freelens cluster frames, and a request with any other `Origin`, or with a `Host` other than `127.0.0.1:<port>` (DNS rebinding), is refused;
  - the token is handed to cluster frames over IPC and is no longer saved to `bridge-store.json`; the token an older version saved there is overwritten on activation.

## Dependencies

- Built against `@freelensapp/extensions` 2.0.0 and the Freelens 2.0.0 stack.
- `@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk` ^0.3.312, `diff` ^9.0.0, `yaml` ^2.9.1.
- `@kubernetes/client-node` removed.

## Assets

Besides the `.tgz` for install from the Extensions page, the release carries an SPDX SBOM, `prod-packages.json` (the npm packages bundled into `dist/`) and a SHA-256 checksum for each; every asset has a build provenance attestation.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-for-claude-extension/compare/v0.2.0...v1.0.0
